notes: Requests run sequentially. Candidate code evolved between screening batches; deferred-http uses the saved final candidate hash. Earlier minimum-direction batches overpruned feasible patterns and are preliminary; see implementation_version.
process_ms means process lifetime for CLI, client request wall time for HTTP. HTTP startup is recorded separately.
HTTP CPU time includes startup/health/shutdown; average_cpu_cores uses full child lifetime.
Reference is partial; provisional and undecided reference probabilities are excluded from scoring.
All positions in comparison deltas are one-based.
